title: Operations
subtitle: Inpatient operations, supplies and surgeon payments
listHint: Plan an operation, record the supplies used and track the final cost and surgeon payment.
admissionHint: Operations and their supplies are added to this admission’s charges. Create the patient invoice from the Charges tab.
scheduleHint: Select an active admission, operation from the catalogue and responsible surgeon. The operation fee is added to the admission’s charges.
loadError: Could not load data. Please retry.
created: Surgery scheduled and invoice sent to cashier
searchPlaceholder: Patient, medical record number or operation…
invalidDates: End date must not precede start date.
emptyHint: Scheduled operations appear here. Try changing your filters.
forbidden: You do not have access to operations.
chargesHint: Surgery fees, materials and anesthesia medicines are automatically invoiced when saved. Additional charges receive a new invoice.
cancelledHint: This operation was cancelled. Its record is available for review.
closedAdmissionHint: This admission is closed. Supplies cannot be changed.
usageHint: Choose an item from the relevant catalogue or enter its name, unit and price manually. Quantities support up to three decimal places.
usageInvalid: Check the item, positive quantity, unit and price (up to 2 decimal places).
removeHint: Remove this uninvoiced item? Its cancelled record will remain in history.
completeHint: Confirm that the operation is complete. Its current cost becomes available to reception and the cashier for surgeon payment.
cancelOperationHint: Cancel this operation and its uninvoiced fee? Its record will remain in history.
payoutHint: The percentage uses the operation price only, excluding materials, medicines and extra staff services. This records an actual cash payment to staff as a separate expense.
payoutInvalid: Enter a positive amount or a percentage no greater than 100, with up to 2 decimal places.
openShiftRequired: Open a cashier shift before making a payment.
completeBeforePayout: Surgeon payment becomes available after the operation is completed.
voidHint: The linked expense will be voided and the amount restored to its payment account. Provide the reason.

batch.hint: Add materials or medicines on separate rows, then save them all together. Quantities support up to 3 decimal places. Catalogue prices are filled automatically.
batch.invalid: Correct the highlighted rows. All rows must be valid before saving.
batch.discardHint: Your unsaved rows will be lost.

errors.service: Select a catalogue item with a configured price.
errors.title: Enter a name (up to 200 characters).
errors.quantity: Enter a positive quantity: up to 9 integer and 3 decimal digits.
errors.unitPrice: Enter a price: up to 12 integer and 2 decimal digits.
errors.note: The note must not exceed 500 characters.

staffFees.title: Staff services
staffFees.hint: Optional patient charges added on top of the operation price.
staffFees.formHint: Select the staff roles and enter their fees. All selected services are saved together and sent to the cashier for the patient to pay.
staffFees.empty: No additional staff services. Add surgeon, anesthesiologist or nurse fees if applicable.
staffFees.invalidAmount: Enter a positive amount with up to 12 whole digits and 2 decimal places.
staffFees.payoutSeparation: These amounts are owed by the patient. Cash payments to staff are recorded separately; no expense is created automatically.
staffFees.saved: Staff services added and sent to the cashier
staffFees.removeHint: Cancel this service that is not included in an invoice? Its history will be retained.
